mapper.select: SELECT D.COMN_DTL_CD AS CD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_NM AS NM FROM TB_EEP_COMN_CD_M C JOIN TB_EEP_COMN_DTL_CD_S D ON D.COMN_CD_SQ = C.COMN_CD_SQ WHERE C.COMN_CD = 'CARD_USE' AND C.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.DEL_YN = 'N' AND D.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD IS NULL, D.COMN_DTL_CD_ORD, D.COMN_DTL_CD_SQ

SELECT C.CARD_SQ, C.CARD_NM, C.CARD_CO, C.LAST4, C.HOLDER_NM, C.USE_YN , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D U WHERE U.CARD_SQ = C.CARD_SQ AND DATE_FORMAT(U.USE_DT, '%Y-%m') = #{YM}) AS MONTH_CNT , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(U.AMT), 0) FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D U WHERE U.CARD_SQ = C.CARD_SQ AND DATE_FORMAT(U.USE_DT, '%Y-%m') = #{YM}) AS MONTH_AMT , (SELECT MAX(S.YM) FROM TB_EEP_CARD_SETTLE_M S WHERE S.CARD_SQ = C.CARD_SQ) AS LAST_SETTLE_YM FROM TB_EEP_CARD_M C WHERE C.CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} ORDER BY C.USE_YN DESC, C.CARD_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CARD_M (CARD_NM, CARD_CO, LAST4, HOLDER_NM, USE_YN, UPDT_EMPLY_ID, UPDT_DT) VALUES (#{CARD_NM}, NULLIF(#{CARD_CO}, ''), #{LAST4}, NULLIF(#{HOLDER_NM}, ''), #{USE_YN}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT USE_SQ, CARD_SQ, DATE_FORMAT(USE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS USE_DT, AMT, USE_CD, DETAIL, MERCHANT FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D WHERE CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN CONCAT(#{YM}, '-01') AND LAST_DAY(CONCAT(#{YM}, '-01')) ORDER BY USE_DT, USE_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D (CARD_SQ, USE_DT, AMT, USE_CD, DETAIL, REG_EMPLY_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{CARD_SQ}, #{USE_DT}, #{AMT}, #{USE_CD}, NULLIF(#{DETAIL}, ''), #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D WHERE USE_SQ = #{USE_SQ} AND CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_CARD_USE_D SET MERCHANT = NULLIF(#{MERCHANT}, '') WHERE USE_SQ = #{USE_SQ} AND CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND USE_DT BETWEEN CONCAT(#{YM}, '-01') AND LAST_DAY(CONCAT(#{YM}, '-01'))
mapper.select: SELECT CARD_SQ, YM, FILE_NM, EXCEL_CNT, MATCH_CNT, DONE_EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(DONE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS DONE_DT FROM TB_EEP_CARD_SETTLE_M WHERE CARD_SQ = #{CARD_SQ} AND YM = #{YM}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_CARD_SETTLE_M (CARD_SQ, YM, FILE_NM, EXCEL_CNT, MATCH_CNT, DONE_EMPLY_ID, DONE_DT) VALUES (#{CARD_SQ}, #{YM}, NULLIF(#{FILE_NM}, ''), #{EXCEL_CNT}, #{MATCH_CNT}, #{UPDT_EMPLY_ID}, DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 9 HOUR)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE FILE_NM = VALUES(FILE_NM), EXCEL_CNT = VALUES(EXCEL_CNT), MATCH_CNT = VALUES(MATCH_CNT), DONE_EMPLY_ID = VALUES(DONE_EMPLY_ID), DONE_DT = VALUES(DONE_DT)
